description: Figure 4. qwen7b_subspace: Qwen2.5-7B held-out query-dependent states (test word sets) in the 3-dim address subspace fit on calibration word sets, in units of the mean address distance, with the four fact addresses (template_xyz). spacing: for lists of 4, 6, 8 facts, the fact addresses in their first principal directions and the distance between neighbouring addresses (unit: distance between the first two addresses), and per destination fact the distance to its nearest other address and the ordinal vector's designated-answer rate. spacing_vs_transfer: least-squares fit after removing each model's mean (all models, lengths, positions).
